verdict.rationale: Algolia's Search API manages individual records in indices, and its data guide is about sending and updating your data to the hosted copy Algolia searches (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-54, algolia-docs-48). A community user kept Algolia in sync with Firebase through a single cloud function, which implies record-level updates rather than full reindexes (algolia-comm-16). However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents add/update/delete operations or how quickly changes become searchable. missing for 10: explicit docs for per-record add/partial-update/delete operations, any evidence of near-real-time indexing latency, independent corroboration that changes appear quickly without a reindex.
